AC amendment (gap-analysis): invocation target files exist — assert each engine/wrapper's referenced harness file exists on disk (bash-runner.sh, suite-engine.sh, validate.sh, run-hook-tests.sh, and test-batched.sh for the bash-runner composite). NOTE: do NOT assert verdict_adapter PATH resolves — it is an intentional forward reference to sc-3 which has not yet created the adapter.
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && test -f plugins/dso/scripts/runners/bash-runner.sh && test -f tests/lib/suite-engine.sh && test -f plugins/dso/scripts/validate.sh && test -f tests/hooks/run-hook-tests.sh && test -f plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh && echo OK
